title: Entropy score Brownian motion has no omega-limit point with four positive actions
checked_scope: One-player entropy FTRL with fixed action payoffs and constant nondegenerate score Brownian noise; interior initialization.
significance: Strengthens boundary containment to the two-dimensional simplex skeleton for arbitrarily many tied best actions, and extends the zero-payoff calculation to fixed unequal payoffs.
